steps.title: An even number
steps.hint: Which number makes pairs with none left over?
steps.explanation: Six makes three pairs with none left over.
steps.shortExplanation: Six makes three pairs with none left over.

steps.title: After 2nd
steps.hint: Say first, second, then the next position.

steps.title: Double 4
steps.explanation: Four and another four make eight.
steps.shortExplanation: Four and another four make eight.

steps.title: Adding 6 and 11
steps.hint: Start on 11, the bigger number, and count on 6.
steps.explanation: Start at eleven and count on six to reach seventeen.
steps.shortExplanation: Start at eleven and count on six to reach seventeen.

steps.title: Faces of a dice
steps.prompt: A dice is a cube. How many faces does a dice have?
steps.hint: Count each flat face of a dice once.
steps.explanation: A dice is a cube, and a cube has six square faces.
steps.shortExplanation: A dice is a cube, and a cube has six square faces.

steps.title: An upside-down triangle
steps.prompt: A triangle turns upside down. Is it still a triangle?
steps.hint: Count its sides and corners after turning.
steps.explanation: It still has three straight sides and three corners.
steps.shortExplanation: It still has three straight sides and three corners.

steps.title: The most in a graph
steps.prompt: Which graph column shows the most?
steps.hint: More blocks make a taller column.
steps.explanation: The tallest column has the greatest count.
steps.shortExplanation: The tallest column has the greatest count.

steps.title: Sharing 20 fairly
steps.prompt: Share 20 sweets fairly between 2 friends. How many does each friend get?
steps.explanation: Two equal groups of ten make twenty, so each friend gets ten.
steps.shortExplanation: Two equal groups of ten make twenty, so each friend gets ten.

steps.title: Reading the clock
steps.prompt: What time does this clock show?
steps.hint: Look at the long hand first, then the short hand.
steps.explanation: The minute hand is on twelve; the hour hand is on two.
steps.shortExplanation: The minute hand is on twelve; the hour hand is on two.

steps.title: Weighing flour
steps.prompt: What do we use to weigh flour?
steps.hint: Which tool shows how heavy something is?
steps.explanation: Scales measure mass, so use them to weigh flour.
steps.shortExplanation: Scales measure mass, so use them to weigh flour.

parentNote.en: Drawing and personal answers are discussed with an adult and are not automatically graded. Estimate first; a guess is not a scored answer.
parentNote.ar: الرسم والإجابات الشخصية بنتناقش فيها مع شخص كبير ومش بنقيّمها تلقائيًا. التوقع الأول مش إجابة عليها درجات.
